mapper.sql: id, instance_id, step_code, seq, type, status, progress_current, version, activated_at, completed_at, skip_reason, last_biz_no, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_instance_step WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY seq ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE task_instance_step SET status = 'ACTIVE', activated_at = #{activatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'INACTIVE'
UPDATE task_instance_step SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE task_instance_step SET status = 'SKIPPED', skip_reason = #{skipReason}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE task_instance_step SET progress_current = #{progressCurrent}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
